one_line: Personified voices of the different records and memories through which historians reconstruct King Harsha’s reign.

appearance.age_look: Early 20s, medium height, slim but wiry build with a studious posture that becomes animated when debating.
appearance.face: Oval face with a calm, wheat-brown North Indian complexion, straight nose, sharp black eyes behind thin round metal-rim spectacles, a faint scholarly frown line between the brows, default expression thoughtful but easily shifting into animated argument.
appearance.hair: Straight, black hair parted slightly off-center, tied into a neat low knot at the back of the head; a simple narrow off-white headband encircles the forehead, holding a few loose strands in place.
appearance.costume: Era-neutral but historically grounded scholar’s outfit: an ankle-length off-white cotton angarkha-style robe with a cross-tied front and narrow sleeves, lightly patterned with faint beige block-printed floral vines, worn over a pale grey dhoti-like lower wrap visible below the knee; a muted indigo cotton shawl with a thin red border drapes over the left shoulder and around the back; simple dark brown leather sandals; minimal jewellery except for a small copper signet ring on the right hand and a slender black-thread amulet around the neck.
appearance.signature: A bundled set of four distinct scrolls and plates carried together under the left arm—one palm-leaf manuscript tied in red string, one copper plate with engraved seal hanging from a cord, one slightly worn birch-bark roll, and one narrow bamboo tally-stick—plus a slim reed pen tucked behind the right ear.

ref_desc: Harsha’s Sources is a slim early-twenties scholar with wheat-brown oval face, round spectacles, black hair in a low knot and off-white angarkha, grey wrap, indigo shawl and bundled scrolls and copper plate under one arm with reed pen behind the ear.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of a single consistent character named Harsha’s Sources: a slim early-twenties North Indian scholar with an oval wheat-brown face, sharp black eyes behind thin round metal-rim spectacles, and straight black hair parted slightly off-center and tied into a neat low knot at the back, held by a simple narrow off-white headband; dress them in an ankle-length off-white cotton angarkha-style robe with a cross-tied front and faint beige block-printed floral vines, over a pale grey dhoti-like lower wrap visible below the knee, and drape a muted indigo cotton shawl with a thin red border over the left shoulder and around the back, finished with simple dark brown leather sandals, a small copper signet ring on the right hand, and a slender black-thread amulet at the neck; in their left arm they cradle a bundled set of four distinct records—a palm-leaf manuscript tied with red string, a copper plate with an engraved seal on a cord, a slightly worn birch-bark roll, and a narrow bamboo tally-stick—while a slim reed pen is tucked behind the right ear; show the character from front, side, and back in one image, keeping the colours off-white, indigo, pale grey, muted red, and dark brown dominant, and emphasize their thoughtful default expression that easily shifts into animated debate, ensuring the same face, hair, costume, and bundled documents appear consistently in every view.
